FICTIONAL TEST REPORT
MRI KNEE, LEFT
Date of examination: 14/06/2025
Clinical details: Twisting injury playing football, locking and swelling.
Technique: Proton density fat saturated sequences in three planes and sagittal T1.
FINDINGS:
There is a bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus, with the displaced fragment lying in the intercondylar notch (the double posterior cruciate ligament sign). The anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex are normal. There is a moderate joint effusion measuring 22 mm in the suprapatellar pouch. Bone marrow oedema is seen in the lateral femoral condyle consistent with a contusion. The articular cartilage is preserved apart from a 5 mm area of grade 2 chondral thinning on the medial femoral condyle. The extensor mechanism is intact.
IMPRESSION:
1. Displaced bucket-handle tear of the left medial meniscus.
2. Moderate effusion and lateral femoral condyle bone bruise.
